project_title: Tony Yoga - Advanced Admin Shell & Performance Dashboard

typography.eyebrow: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; 11px; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #839682;

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-medium serif leading-tight
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-medium serif leading-tight

design_rules.theme: Light mode primary with organic dark contrast sections (#1C221F). Dashboard follows High Density Grid rules.
design_rules.border_radius: rounded-3xl for outer containers, rounded-2xl for inner elements/inputs, rounded-full for pills/toggles.
design_rules.spacing: Generous spacing (p-6 to p-10 for cards). For admin dense layouts: p-4 to p-6, gap-4 to gap-6.
design_rules.buttons: Pill buttons with hover state transitions and active press states (.pill, .pill-primary, .pill-ghost)
design_rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for body text and interactive states. Always specify hover text color explicitly.
design_rules.dashboard_layout: Full viewport height (h-screen) flex layout. Fixed left sidebar (w-64 or w-72) with vertical navigation, and a scrollable main content area (flex-1). Never use center-everything.
design_rules.charts: Use Recharts. Organic colors for lines/bars (terracotta, sage). Subtle grid lines, transparent backgrounds.

testing_requirements.rule: ALL interactive elements, form inputs, toggles, status indicators, and navigation links MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes

admin_auth_redirect.location: Login/Auth flow (e.g., Login.jsx or auth callback)
admin_auth_redirect.functionality: Role-aware redirection. Fix the bug where admins go to normal user console first. If user.role === 'admin', redirect directly to '/admin'.

admin_shell_navigation.functionality: Transform the current layout into a modern admin shell: a persistent left-side navigation sidebar for all 20+ management menus (Pages, Classes, Shop, etc.), keeping current functionality but adopting a full-height flex layout.

advanced_admin_dashboard.functionality: Modern 'top graph' visualizing website and native/PWA app performance (page views, session durations) over time. Below it, key business metrics (sales, signups, active users) in a 'Bento' grid, alongside recent activity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve existing Tony Yoga design system (#B25A45 terracotta accent, Fraunces serif headings, #1C221F ink dark cards, #FAFAF7 cream background) but adapt for a dense Dashboard environment.
Refactor Admin.jsx from a max-w-6xl centered layout to a modern full-bleed dashboard shell: <div className='flex h-screen bg-cream_bg'> with a fixed sidebar <aside> and scrollable <main>.
Fix the login redirection logic so admin users navigate directly to /admin instead of the normal user view.
Revamp StatsPane.jsx into an Advanced Dashboard. Include a large, polished Area/Line Chart using Recharts showing website vs app performance over time.
Use Recharts for metrics. Avoid standard 'Vercel' looks; use organic colors (sage and terracotta) for chart lines, with custom Tooltips matching the organic theme.
Structure the dashboard using the 'Bento' grid protocol (Mode B): dense, data correlation, strict hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating headers; use solid colors or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur + bg-opacity).
Avoid applying generic `transition-all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Do not add global centered text alignment. Keep text left-aligned for natural reading flow.
Ensure hover states explicitly declare text colors (e.g., hover:bg-ink hover:text-white).
Use pill-shaped or rounded-xl modern buttons.
Avoid AI emojis in UI, use Phosphor or Lucide icons instead.
